title: Firefox’s Smart Window promises a better AI browser
slides: Firefox's Smart Window: a better browser, or a smarter trap?
It embeds AI that predicts your next tab before you click.
The catch: it learns from everything you type, even deletions.
What changes: your browser starts finishing your sentences for you.
Test it on a throwaway profile before trusting it with real work.
thread_text:
1. Your browser is watching

Firefox's new AI predicts your next tab by learning from every keystroke — including the ones you delete.

2. The trap is subtle

It doesn't just autocomplete. It starts finishing your sentences, changing how you type without you noticing.

3. Deletions are data

Every backspace teaches the AI what you didn't mean. That's a memory of your mistakes — stored and used.

4. Trust is the real issue

Would you let a browser finish your thoughts? It might guess wrong more often than you think.

5. Test it safely

Try it on a throwaway profile before using it for real work. Would you risk your main account on a guess?

instagram.caption:
Your browser is learning from every backspace you hit — Firefox’s new AI-powered Smart Window turns even your deletions into data.  
It predicts your next tab and finishes your sentences before you finish typing.  
The catch: it’s watching everything you write, including what you erase. That’s a permanent record of your mistakes.  
For anyone drafting posts or scripts, this means your drafts aren’t just output — they’re training material.  
Would you test this on your main profile, or does the thought of it knowing your typos make you pause? 🖱️🧠
